title: Student Voice and Feedback
description: CAT 531 textbook section connecting student voice and feedback to a disaggregated exit-form trace showing the collection method, subgroup table, AI-theming check, the lesson change, and the report-back to students, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Distinguish performative feedback (claps, popularity) from feedback that can change a decision
Gather voice in a form that lets dissent survive, anonymous and specific rather than public and general
Refuse to average a subgroup's critical signal away, and document the subgroup split
Close the loop: show how feedback changed the lesson and report the change back to students

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
